bays.restriction: Resident permit zone AW (Abbey Wood), London Borough of Bexley. During the controlled hours, marked bays are for permit holders; visitors visiting a resident use visitor scratch cards (booklet of 10 for £22; one card validates one day). Zone centre point — the zone's streets are signed at its boundary.
bays.tariff: No hourly visitor tariff — permit holders and visitor scratch cards only
bays.pay: Visitor scratch cards (from residents); permits online from the council
bays.permits: Resident permit £41 for 3 months / £135 for 1 year; visitor scratch cards £22 per booklet of 10 (council permit charges tables)
